rows.transcript_1:
Close your eyes. 

Take a minute to think about the day.

Think about one positive or fun thing you did.
Praise yourself for one thing you did well today. 
Think of one thing you can do differently tomorrow.  
Think of one thing that you are grateful for.
rows.transcript_2:
Tutup mata anda.

Luangkan satu minit untuk memikirkan tentang hari ini.

Fikirkan satu perkara positif atau menyeronokkan yang anda lakukan.
Puji diri anda untuk satu perkara yang anda lakukan dengan baik hari ini.
Fikirkan satu perkara yang anda boleh lakukan dengan cara berbeza esok.
Fikirkan satu perkara yang membuatkan anda rasa bersyukur.
rows.title: Think about today

text_1.eng: Take a moment to notice how you are doing.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng: Great! So good to hear that you are in a good space today. What a wonderful feeling!

quiz_1_feedback_2.eng: Some days will have their challenges. That is okay. You are on the right path!

quiz_1_feedback_3.eng: Sorry that things are difficult now. It is completely normal to struggle sometimes. Remember that you are not alone!

There are four steps to building a family budget. 💰You have already covered:
1️⃣ Step 1: identifying needs and wants.

2️⃣ Today, you will learn about Step 2: talking about monthly expenses.

text_2.eng:
🔑 Knowing what your family’s monthly expenses are can be helpful for everyone in your family. 

💡 It can help them understand why money is being spent on some things and not on others.
